descriptions.w3d_ai_clone_and_enqueue_8000c078: Marks the plan active, clears its amount byte, clones it, and enqueues the clone.
descriptions.w3d_ai_weapon_damage_8000ce84: Reads weapon damage and applies the damage modifier.
descriptions.w3d_ai_test_range_a_8000d068: Runs a range query and passes its result to the plan continuation.
descriptions.w3d_ai_test_range_b_8000d0b4: Runs a range query, rejects excessive result height, and continues the plan.
descriptions.w3d_ai_test_range_c_8000d120: Runs a query with a fixed range parameter.
descriptions.w3d_ai_test_raised_origin_8000d1dc: Raises the query origin and continues the plan after the query.
descriptions.w3d_ai_test_range_d_8000d2c8: Runs a range query, continues the plan, and sets a fixed result cost.
descriptions.w3d_ai_test_range_e_8000d328: Runs a range query with an alternate fixed parameter and continues the plan.
descriptions.w3d_ai_named_damage_8000d99c: Reads named weapon damage, optionally multiplies by count, and applies the damage modifier.
descriptions.w3d_ai_named_range_8000da0c: Reads the named weapon range property.
descriptions.w3d_ai_named_scaled_count_8000da34: Multiplies a named weapon damage scale by its unsigned count.
descriptions.w3d_ai_execute_named_attack_8000dbd4: Appears to execute a named attack and conditionally release its queue and select a weapon.
descriptions.w3d_ai_execute_fixed_a_8000dc78: Executes a fixed action with tuning value 14.
descriptions.w3d_ai_execute_fixed_b_8000dcbc: Executes a fixed action with tuning value 13.
